1860 is a leap year (divisible by 4, not a century year unless divisible by 400, 1860 mod 400 = 60, so leap year).  
Days from 1860-05-20 to end of 1860:  
May: 31-20 = 11 days left in May.  
June 30, July 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31, Nov 30, Dec 31 → total = 11+30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 225 days left in 1860 after May 20.  
314 - 225 = 89 days into 1861.  
1861 is not leap (1861 mod 4 = 1). Jan 31, Feb 28 → 31+28 = 59 days. Remaining 89 - 59 = 30 days into March → March 30, 1861.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1861-03-30
